# HostTracker .NET SDK

> The official .NET client for the HostTracker API v2 - uptime, blacklist, certificate and instant
> checks, contacts and alerting, webhooks, status pages and reports. The typed surface is generated
> from the published OpenAPI document; a hand-written layer adds auth, retry, idempotency, paging,
> job and instant-check polling, and webhook verification.

Package `HostTracker.Sdk`, target `net8.0`, base URL `https://api2.host-tracker.com`.

```bash
dotnet add package HostTracker.Sdk
```

## Quick start

```csharp
using HostTracker.Sdk;
using HostTracker.Sdk.Generated;

using var client = new HostTrackerClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("HT_TOKEN"));

// 1. List monitors.
var page = await client.Monitors.ListMonitorAsync(limit: 50);
foreach (var m in page.Data)
    Console.WriteLine($"{m.Name,-30} {m.State} since {UnixTime.ToDateTimeOffset(m.Since):u}");

// 2. Create one.
var created = await client.Monitors.CreateMonitorAsync(new MonitorWriteRequest
{
    Type = MonitorTypes.Http,
    Url = "https://example.com",
    Name = "Marketing site",
    Interval = 5,
    Locations = new MonitorLocations { Pools = new[] { "allworld" } },
});

// 3. Run an on-demand check and wait for the verdict.
var result = await client.RunCheckAsync(new IcCreateRequest { Url = "https://example.com", Type = "http" });

// 4. Verify a webhook delivery, in your endpoint, on the RAW bytes.
var verdict = WebhookSignature.Verify(request.Headers, rawBody, secrets: new[] { webhookSecret });
verdict.EnsureValid();
var evt = WebhookEvent.Parse(rawBody);
```

Operations are grouped by their API family and each method is named after its `operationId`:
`Monitors`, `MonitorTypes`, `Results`, `Incidents`, `Maintenance`, `Contacts`, `Alerts`, `Reports`,
`Webhooks`, `StatusPages`, `Account`, `MonitoringLocations`, `InstantChecks` (alias `Checks`),
`Jobs`. The client is thread-safe and long-lived: build one per process, or register it as a
singleton, not one per call. Every failure - a problem document, an HTML 502 from a proxy, a DNS
failure, a timeout - arrives as a single `HostTrackerException`; branch on `Code`, never on
`StatusCode` alone.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#readme): the full guide, sections below.
- [Quick start](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#quick-start): token, first calls, webhook verification.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#configuration): `HostTrackerOptions` - token, base URL, timeout, retries, idempotency, handler.
- [Operations](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#operations): the families, the body-query twins, the two binary endpoints.
- [Errors](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#errors): `HostTrackerException`, `ProblemCodes`, `IsCode`.
- [Retries and idempotency](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#retries-and-idempotency): what is retried, automatic `Idempotency-Key`.
- [Response metadata](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#response-metadata): request id, rate-limit snapshot, replay flag.
- [Paging](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#paging): cursor walking and `syncCursor`.
- [Jobs](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#jobs): waiting on the 202 bulk doors.
- [Instant checks](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#instant-checks): `RunCheckAsync`.
- [Webhooks](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#webhooks): `WebhookSignature.Verify`, rotation, `WebhookEvent.Parse`.
- [Timestamps](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#timestamps): Unix seconds, `UnixTime`.
- [Staying forward compatible](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#staying-forward-compatible): absorbing values added after your restore.
- [Regenerating the client](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet#regenerating-the-client): NSwag, `HT_SPEC=…`.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## The API

- [API reference](https://www.host-tracker.com/apidocs/v2): every operation, by tag.
- [Guides](https://www.host-tracker.com/apidocs/v2/guide): authentication, paging, jobs, webhooks, errors.
- [API tokens](https://www.host-tracker.com/integrations/api): mint a token and pick its scopes.
- [OpenAPI document](https://api2.host-tracker.com/openapi/v2.json): the contract this client is generated from.
- [openapi repository](https://github.com/HostTracker/openapi): the published document, its twins and the contract facts.
- [MCP server](https://mcp.host-tracker.com/mcp): streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint for AI agents.
- [Problem codes](https://api2.host-tracker.com/problems/): `https://api2.host-tracker.com/problems/{code}`.

## Sibling clients

- [hosttracker-sdk-js](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-js): `npm install @hosttracker/sdk`.
- [hosttracker-sdk-python](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-python): `pip install hosttracker`.
- [hosttracker-sdk-go](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-go): `go get github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-go`.
- [ht-cli](https://github.com/HostTracker/cli): the command-line client.
- [SDK overview](https://www.host-tracker.com/integrations/sdk): all clients, on the HostTracker site.

## Optional

- [NuGet package](https://www.nuget.org/packages/HostTracker.Sdk): published releases.
- [Issues](https://github.com/HostTracker/hosttracker-sdk-dotnet/issues): bugs and questions about this client. MIT licensed.
